sloka: यो रामम् प्रतियुध्येत समरे वासव उपमम् ।अवध्यः समरे रामो न एवम् त्वम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-४५-१३॥
transliteration: yo rāmam pratiyudhyeta samare vāsava upamam ।avadhyaḥ samare rāmo na evam tvam vaktum arhasi ॥3-45-13॥

translations.english: Rama is indestructible in war. It is not proper for you to say what you said. When he is not here I do not wish to leave you alone here in the forest.
